title: Step 1
prompt: Accept a single downward-pointing triangle with a long horizontal top edge and two diagonal edges meeting at the lower point. Reject an unfolded square or diamond, or any shape with visible extra flaps.

title: Step 2
prompt: Accept an upright kite or diamond shape with left and right outer points, a top point, a bottom point, and two narrow folded flaps meeting along the vertical center near the bottom. Reject a flat downward triangle or a plain diamond with no narrow center flaps.

title: Step 3
prompt: Accept a diamond shape with a horizontal crease across the middle and two narrow upright folded flaps at the top center. Reject a closed kite or diamond with no clear horizontal middle crease.

title: Step 4
prompt: Accept a large lower diamond with a horizontal middle crease, symmetric triangular flaps opened upward on the left and right, and a narrow vertical flap at the top center. Reject a plain diamond or any shape with the side flaps still folded inward.

title: Step 5
prompt: Accept a model with the upper leaf-like flaps visible and the large front triangular flap raised over the center, with its base across the middle and its point near the upper center. Reject if the front triangular flap remains flat or points downward.

title: Step 6
prompt: Accept a model with the upper leaf-like flaps visible, a small centered triangle above a wide horizontal band across the middle, and a large downward diamond below the band. Reject any model with the large front triangle still raised instead of folded into the band.

title: Step 7
prompt: Accept a model with the upper leaf-like flaps visible and a long shallow horizontal base formed from the lower section. Reject if a large downward diamond still hangs below the middle band.
